name: Entry
fixed: Original 1940s staircase with oak treads and iron balusters
description: Entry hall of a 1940s colonial. White painted board walls, original stair on the left with oak treads, painted risers and thin black iron balusters. Paneled front door with divided-light sidelights. Original oak strip floor. Lantern pendant. Wall hooks, narrow black metal console and round brass mirror. Doorway to a sage green room on the right.
